premises.text: Healthcare should let doctors, nurses, labs, and pharmacies collaborate nationwide as if in one hospital
premises.evidence_span: imagining this health care system where doctors, nurses, labs, pharmacies, all across the country can collaborate

premises.text: Most hospital functions are administrative and replaceable by a technology platform that connects patients to doctors
premises.evidence_span: The hospital itself is mostly an administrative layer that handles things like registration, billing, and shared access to medical records

premises.text: Carbon delivers easy insurance-based onboarding, an actionable longitudinal chart, messaging, and automated intake on the phone
premises.evidence_span: Onboarding with Carbon couldn't be easier

premises.text: Hybrid virtual and clinic care preserves context in both directions
premises.evidence_span: when you leave the clinic, you can choose to do follow-ups virtually if you wish

premises.text: Owning physician and patient applications plus integrations yields experiences traditional providers cannot match
premises.evidence_span: since you control your experience all the way from the physician applications to the patient applications and integrations with third parties

value.text: Best possible care via a ubiquitous technology platform connecting people with their doctors
value.evidence_span: a ubiquitous technology platform that connects us with our doctors
